findings.title: The projected missile pool has no occupancy encoding
findings.claim: The new projected Space field list omits a way to distinguish an empty missile slot from an occupied one.
findings.why: Missile slots can be null, and ship slot 0 is a valid owner. The current canonical missile encoding uses a presence flag. A plan writer must guess how clients identify occupied slots in the fixed-length projection.
findings.fix: Specify a presence flag for each projected missile slot, with all remaining fields zero when the slot is empty.

prior.note: The revised layout projects Space and redacts AI controller rows for ships the recipient does not control; the allowlist and privacy test now cover the decoded Space partition (spec L222, L238-L239).
